quality_parameters.parameter: Moisture Content (not more than, % by mass)

quality_parameters.fssr_limit: Not more than 1.0 per cent by mass , of which not more than 0.25 per cent by mass shall be mineral matter and not more than 0.10 per cent by mass shall be impurities of animal origin.

quality_parameters.parameter: Other edible grains (not more than, % by mass)
Grains with serious defects. (Grain in which the cotyledon has been affected or attacked by pests; grains with very slight traces of mould or decay; or cotyledon staining.) (not more than, % by mass)

Grains with slight defects. (Grains which have not reached normal development; grains with extensive seed coat staining, without the cotyledon being affected; grains in which the seed coat is wrinkled, with pronounced folding or broken grain) (not more than, % by mass)
Weevilled Grains, (not more than, % by count)
Immature and Shrivelled grains (not more than, % by mass)
